long_biography.plain_text:
Volodymyr Yudayev's career has centred on commercial shipping and chartering. He worked as a chartering manager at Industrial Carriers before taking a similar role with Columbus Maritime, a subsidiary of Vista Shipping. By 2017 he was also associated with Smart Trading LLP in Ukraine's maritime-trading community.

A Singapore corporate dispute concerning Waler Pte Ltd brought Yudayev into another business setting. He applied for permission to bring a derivative action in Waler's name over alleged breaches of fiduciary duties by another director. Related proceedings referred to loan documents involving Waler, Yudayev and that director, placing his activity at the intersection of shipping, commodity trading and cross-border finance.
